title: Five South Florida Parking Lots That Started Family Beef
igCaption:
Some of y'all park like the lease is ending.
Which South Florida lot makes you say a prayer before the ticket machine?
(satire)
#Miami #MiamiBeach #Brickell #Kendall #Aventura #MidtownMiami #SouthFlorida #DadeCounty #BrowardCounty #PalmBeach #ParkingLot #MiamiProblems

scenes.text: If you defend these lots, you're the menace, and number one should lose its permit.
Number five, Fifth and Alton Publix. I watched a Mercedes circle level two at six p.m. for one lime. Twenty minutes. The lime won.
scenes.caption: Number five, Fifth and Alton Publix. I watched a Mercedes circle level 2 at 6 PM for one lime. 20 minutes. The lime won.

scenes.text: Number four, Dadeland Mall by Cheesecake Factory. Last Saturday, two SUVs stared down one spot off Kendall Drive. Nobody parked. Cheesecake got cold.
scenes.caption: Number four, Dadeland Mall by Cheesecake Factory. Last Saturday, 2 SUVs stared down one spot off Kendall Drive. Nobody parked. Cheesecake got cold.

scenes.text: Number three, stay for number one, I'm dead serious. Brickell City Centre level four trapped me forty-five minutes. Cologne, brake pads, zero dignity.
scenes.caption: Number three, stay for #1, I'm dead serious. Brickell City Centre level 4 trapped me 45 minutes. Cologne, brake pads, zero dignity.

scenes.text: Number two, Aventura Mall Nordstrom garage off Northeast one ninety-fifth. My cousin lost level three, bought socks to look busy. Don't leave; number one fights back.
scenes.caption: Number two, Aventura Mall Nordstrom garage off NE 195th. My cousin lost level 3, bought socks to look busy. Don't leave; #1 fights back.

scenes.text: And number one... Trader Joe's Midtown, Northeast First and Thirty-second. I saw a Prius block three cars for Greek yogurt. Tow the whole building.
scenes.caption: And number one... Trader Joe's Midtown, NE 1st and 32nd. I saw a Prius block 3 cars for Greek yogurt. Tow the whole building.

scenes.text: Which lot did I miss? Say the address. I want problems.
